name: GPU_RESIDUAL_VALUE
description: H100/H200/B200-class compute assets retain secondary market resale value sufficient to protect loan collateral coverage and advance rates.
observable_proxy: Secondary broker auction clearing prices for 8x H100 SXM5 systems; wholesale depreciation curves in neocloud 10-Ks.
base_case: 3-year residual value >= 45% of original purchase cost; gradual, predictable technological obsolescence.
stress_case: Sudden generation leap or demand pause triggers a 40% immediate drop in secondary hardware clearing values, breaching loan-to-value (LTV) limits.

name: REFINANCING_AVAILABILITY
description: Project debt, revolving facilities, and delayed-draw term loans can be refinanced or rolled over at viable spreads upon maturity.
observable_proxy: Private credit senior loan spreads over SOFR; FINRA TRACE secondary yields on tech/datacenter high-yield notes.
base_case: Spreads remain stable (+350 to +550 bps over SOFR); private credit syndicates eagerly expand capital commitments.
stress_case: Spreads widen +300 bps or asset-backed syndicated markets freeze, forcing borrowers to fund capex from operations or dilutive equity.

name: CLUSTER_UTILIZATION
description: Deployed GPU clusters maintain high commercial billable utilization (>85%) throughout their depreciable lives.
observable_proxy: On-demand spot compute rental rates; reported gross margin progression in neocloud SEC periodic filings.
base_case: Capacity is pre-sold under take-or-pay terms; uncontracted capacity clears on spot market at >= 85% utilization.
stress_case: Spot demand cools, unreserved capacity drops to 60% utilization, and gross margin fails to cover fixed operating lease obligations.

name: POWER_DELIVERY_TIMELINE
description: Regional utilities, ISOs, and substations energize contracted critical IT megawatts according to scheduled development milestones.
observable_proxy: PJM / MISO interconnection queue study progression; FERC docket filings; developer 8-K milestone updates.
base_case: Substations energize within planned 6-month buffer windows; liquidated damages clauses remain dormant.
stress_case: Utility transformer delays or regulatory bottlenecks delay energization by 12-18 months, delaying lease commencement while debt carrying costs accumulate.

name: ANCHOR_CUSTOMER_CONTINUATION
description: Dominant anchor off-takers (e.g., Microsoft representing 67% of CoreWeave FY25 revenue) fulfill full contractual term and exercise renewal/expansion options.
observable_proxy: Customer concentration disclosures in 10-K Footnotes; hyperscaler cloud capex disclosures and internal silicon roadmaps (e.g. Maia chips).
base_case: Hyperscalers continue offloading spillover training/inference demand to specialized neoclouds.
stress_case: Anchor customer decelerates third-party hosting as proprietary custom silicon ramps, exercising termination rights or trimming 30% of optional cluster tiers.

name: HYPERSCALER_CAPEX_EXPANSION
description: Aggregate capital expenditures across the top 4 hyperscalers continue growing at >20% CAGR through 2028.
observable_proxy: Consolidated cash flows from investing (Payments for PP&E) in quarterly 10-Q filings of MSFT, GOOGL, AMZN, META.
base_case: Hyperscaler annual capex exceeds $200B+ aggregate run rate, maintaining hardware backlog.
stress_case: Hyperscalers enter a 'digestion phase' where capex growth slows to 0-5%, creating acute excess inventory down the OEM/silicon supply chain.

name: BACKLOG_CASH_CONVERSION
description: Multi-billion dollar Remaining Performance Obligations (RPO) and signed customer backlogs convert into collected cash revenue without material dispute or restructuring.
observable_proxy: Contract asset balances; allowance for credit losses; quarterly RPO aging schedules.
base_case: 90%+ of backlog converts to cash according to stated schedule.
stress_case: 15-25% of backlog is restructured, postponed, or subject to performance offsets due to software stack delays or power hiccups.
